sources.note: The bank statement sync: the system of record for what a spend line costs and when it is charged. A stand-in folder until the venture's app registers its bank connector (registerConnector) and names it here; Naive never writes it
IT's tool records: the system of record for whether a tool is approved. IT tool records have no record type yet (lead agents build item 7); until then a stand-in folder the it function keeps

rules.note: A spend line lives in the venture folder and the finance function owns it; only finance-agent or a person writes it (writer function)
Finance owns status: active, cancel-requested or cancelled
The bank statement is the system of record for the amount
The currency comes with the amount
The bank statement is the system of record for charge dates
The bank statement is the system of record for renewal dates
IT's tool record is the system of record for approval; the register cites it by id and never copies it

note: The template's source-of-truth matrix (EE-042). Its rules are the access matrix for the spend register, field by field (lead agents design, "The spend register and the access matrix"). A venture copies it to knowledge/sources.json and points each source at its own connector; packages/naive/src/checks/check-sources.mjs refuses two rules that tie.
